workouts.tiebreaker: Last set of successful rope climbs
workouts.name: Maximus - WOD 1
workouts.description:
13 Minute AMREP:

RX:

20/16 Cal Row
20' HSW
2/1 Rope Climb


20/16 Cal Row
40' HSW
3/2 Rope Climbs


20/16 Cal Row
60' HSW
4/3 Rope Climbs

....

Continue adding 20 ft of handstand walks and 1 additional rope climb for each round.

 

INTERMEDIATE:

20/16 Cal Row
2 Wall Walks
2/1 Rope Climbs (12 ft)


20/16 Cal Row
3 Wall Walks
3/2 Rope Climbs


20/16 Cal Row
4 Wall Walks
4/3 Rope Climbs

....

Continue adding 1 wall walk and 1 additional rope climb for each round.

*Rope climb height is 13 ft.

SCALED:

15/12 Cal Row
2 Scaled Wall Walks
2 Zombie Rope Climbs


15/12 Cal Row
3 Scaled Wall Walks
3 Zombie Rope Climbs


15/12 Cal Row
4 Scaled Wall Walks
4 Zombie Rope Climbs

....

Continue adding 1 scaled wall walk and 1 additional zombie rope climb for each round.

 

**Tiebreak time: last fully completed set of zombie rope climbs

workouts.name: Unleash Hell - WOD 2
workouts.description:
Time Cap: 8 minutes

RX:

100 Double Unders

50 GHD Sit-Ups

30 Pistol Squats

10 Squat Snatches (135#/95#)

 

INTERMEDIATE:

80 Double Unders

40 GHD Sit-Ups

30 Front Squats (95#/65#)

10 Snatches (95#/65#)

 

SCALED

100 Single Unders

50 Ab-Mat Sit-Ups

30 Front Squats (75#/55#)

10 Ground-to-Overhead (75#/55#)

 

**Ground-to-overhead may be any of the following movements: Any snatch variation, any clean and jerk variation including strict press or push press, or a cluster (squat clean + thruster).

-Immediately Into Part B-

workouts.name: Are You Not Entertained!? (Part B)
workouts.description:
In Remaining Time From Part A (10 mins total):

For Max Load:

(3) Heaviest Clean & Jerks

 

*Athletes may attempt as many lifts as they want during the remaining time. Only the 3 heaviest lifts will count towards their total. Multiple lifts may be the same weight. Athletes who do not complete 3 successful lifts will receive a "0" for lifts not completed.

 

***Any style clean is permitted

***Any style shoulder-to-overhead is permitted for the jerk

 

*Tiebreak: Part A Score
